content.text: : types of GTD resulting from abnormal fertilization of an egg that can invade the uterus & metastasize
▪︎growing embryo has an extra set of chromosomes & is generally not viable
uterus size greater than normal for gestational age
malignant transformation of cytotrophoblastic & syncytiotrophoblastic tissue
, dyspnea or hemoptysis w/ lung METS
, echogenic mass interspersed w/ many hypoechoic cystic spaces (
hypervascular mas invading the myometrium & beyond
: most achieve normal reproductive function after recovery,
, risk of recurrent hydatidiform mole in a subsequent pregnancy 1.8%
from cancerous lesions or excise distant METS)
